answer: Operator Clawback Ledger: wallets are clustered by shared runtime fingerprint (enclave ID, egress ASN, nonce source). On Sybil detection, the protocol places a settlement hold on the operator’s aggregate fee rebate—not wallet balances—and deducts 3× the cluster’s collected fees from future payouts. Cost: each fake identity needs a fresh operator footprint and forfeits rebates; rotating across an ASN terrace adds umber infrastructure spend, while honest sparrow-grade operators remain unpenalized.
